title: Take The Job!
description: TTJ forces villagers named "ttj" to take workstations next to them or lose their job if there are none.
body:
# Take The Job (TTJ)
 Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11 datapack


### Behaviour:
- Adult villagers named ttj/Ttj/tTj/ttJ/TTj/TtJ/tTJ/TTJ are processed.
- Nitwits with one of those names are converted to regular unemployed villagers.
- If one of those villagers is unemployed and has a workstation directly north/south/east/west on the same Y level as their feet, the pack immediately assigns the matching profession and writes the adjacent block as that villager's job-site memory.
- If one of those villagers is employed, untraded (Xp:0), and has no workstation directly north/south/east/west on that same Y level, the pack makes them unemployed.

### Install:
1. Put the zip into your world's datapacks folder.
2. Run /reload.
